flashcard_questions.q: What is a bug in a program?
flashcard_questions.a: Any error in the code that stops the program working as it should.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the purpose of testing a program?
flashcard_questions.a: Running it with chosen data to reveal bugs before users see them.

flashcard_questions.q: What can testing never prove about a program?
flashcard_questions.a: That it is completely free of bugs.

flashcard_questions.q: When does iterative testing happen during development?
flashcard_questions.a: All the way through, as each small section is written.

flashcard_questions.q: What is final testing carried out on?
flashcard_questions.a: The whole finished program, to check every part works together.

flashcard_questions.q: What does a syntax error break in a program?
flashcard_questions.a: The grammatical rules of the programming language.

flashcard_questions.q: What happens to a program that contains a syntax error?
flashcard_questions.a: It cannot be translated or run at all.

flashcard_questions.q: What does a logic error do to a program's output?
flashcard_questions.a: The program still runs but produces the wrong output.

flashcard_questions.q: Why are logic errors the hardest kind to spot?
flashcard_questions.a: Nothing crashes, so the program gives no clue where it went wrong.

flashcard_questions.q: Which error type is writing prnt(total) instead of print(total)?
What is normal test data used to check?
flashcard_questions.a: Sensible, typical values that the program should accept.
Data of the correct type that sits right on the edge of what is allowed.
Data of the correct type that is out of range and should be rejected.
Data of the wrong type altogether that should be rejected.

flashcard_questions.q: What is a dry run when debugging?
flashcard_questions.a: Following the code by hand, writing down how each variable changes.

notes: 15 cards: 6 term-to-definition, 4 test-data-type cards, 3 error-type behaviour, 2 causal. The invalid/erroneous pair is the exam distinction, so both fronts name the term and the answers separate them by data type. Dropped the test-plan columns card as an enumeration.
